readme:
# Facebook Ad Library Scraper

Scrape any ad from [Meta's public Ad Library](https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/) — Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Messenger, Audience Network. No login, no API key, no access token.

## Why this scraper

- **Paste any Ad Library URL** — all filters in the URL (country, ad type, active status, media type, publisher platforms, content languages, page IDs, date range, sort) are auto-parsed. The easiest way to scrape: apply filters in your browser, copy URL, paste here.
- **Full creative depth** — body text, title, link details, page profile picture, every image, every video (HD + SD + preview + watermarked), every carousel card with its own link and CTA. We pass through Meta's raw creative payload so you never lose a field.
- **Transparency & compliance data** — AAA payer/beneficiary, EU total reach, audience age/gender/country breakdown, content language, violation flags, AI-content detection, sensitive-content flags.
- **Lifetime advertiser spend** — total Meta ad spend by the Page (lower/upper bounds + currency). Useful for sizing competitors.
- **Pay-per-result** — only pay for ads you receive.

## Input sources (mix and match)

| Field | Example | Use when |
|---|---|---|
| `searchUrls` | `https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=all&country=DE&q=nike&search_type=keyword_exact_phrase&publisher_platforms[0]=instagram&start_date[min]=2025-06-01` | You've already built a filtered view in the browser |
| `searchQueries` | `["Tesla Model 3", "electric vehicles"]` | Quick keyword searches across all of Meta's network |
| `pageIds` | `["165991287137890"]` | You know the advertiser's numeric Page ID and want all their ads |
| `advertiserNames` | `["Baulig Consulting"]` | You know the brand name (searched as exact phrase) |

## Filters (apply to keyword / page / advertiser searches)

> **Note**: when you paste a `searchUrl`, filters from that URL take precedence. The fields below apply to `searchQueries`, `pageIds`, and `advertiserNames`.

| Filter | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `country` | ISO code (`US`, `GB`, `DE`, ...) or `ALL` | `ALL` |
| `adType` | `ALL`, `POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS`, `HOUSING_ADS`, `EMPLOYMENT_ADS`, `CREDIT_ADS` | `ALL` |
| `activeStatus` | `ALL`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` | `ALL` |
| `mediaType` | `ALL`, `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, `MEME`, `NONE` | `ALL` |
| `publisherPlatforms` | array of `facebook`, `instagram`, `messenger`, `audience_network`, `whatsapp`, `threads`, `oculus` | all |
| `contentLanguages` | ISO 639-1 codes (`en`, `de`, ...) | all |
| `searchType` | `keyword_unordered` (broad) or `keyword_exact_phrase` (strict) | `keyword_unordered` |
| `sortBy` | `total_impressions_DESC`, `total_impressions_ASC`, `newest_DESC`, ... | relevancy |
| `startDateMin` / `startDateMax` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | none |

## Output fields

Each ad includes **55+ fields** spanning identity, creative, transparency, and run metadata.

**Identity & page**: `ad_archive_id`, `ad_id`, `collation_id` (variant group), `collation_count`, `page_id`, `page_name`, `page_is_deleted`, `page_like_count`, `page_profile_picture_url`, `page_profile_uri`.

**Status & dates**: `is_active`, `start_date` (unix), `end_date`, `start_date_formatted`, `end_date_formatted`, `total_active_time`.

**Distribution**: `publisher_platform[]`, `targeted_or_reached_countries[]`, `categories[]`.

**Creative (top-level convenience)**: `display_format`, `cta_type`, `cta_text`, `link_url`, `link_description`, `title`, `body_text`, `ad_caption`.

**Creative (full payload)**: `snapshot` — Meta's raw creative object containing `body`, `images[]` (original + resized + watermarked URLs), `videos[]` (HD + SD + preview + watermarked), `cards[]` for carousels (each with its own title/body/link/CTA/media), `extra_images`, `extra_videos`, `extra_texts`, `extra_links`, `page_categories`, `branded_content`, `event`, `disclaimer_label`, `brazil_tax_id`, `country_iso_code`, and more.

**Spend & reach**: `currency`, `spend` (lower/upper bounds), `reach_estimate`, `impressions_with_index`.

**Lifetime advertiser spend** (extracted from `advertiser`): `total_advertiser_spend_lower`, `total_advertiser_spend_upper`, `total_advertiser_spend_currency`.

**Transparency (political/issue ads — `aaa_info`)**: `payer_beneficiary_data[]`, `targets_eu`, `eu_total_reach`, `location_audience[]`, `gender_audience`, `age_audience` (min/max), `age_country_gender_reach_breakdown[]` (per-country reach by age/gender), `is_ad_taken_down`.

**Compliance flags**: `is_aaa_eligible`, `gated_type`, `hide_data_status`, `contains_digital_created_media` (AI), `contains_sensitive_content`, `is_violating_eu_siep`, `violation_types[]`, `state_media_run_label`, `fev_info`, `regional_regulation_data`.

**Advertiser metadata** (`advertiser` object): `page.about`, `ad_library_page_info.page_spend` (lifetime), `ad_library_page_info.page_info` (Page metadata).

**Per-jurisdiction transparency** (`transparency_by_location`): BR + EU disclosure data.

**Run metadata**: `ad_library_url` (direct view link), `advertiser_url` (all Page ads), `country`, `search_input`, `source_url`, `scraped_at`.

## Pricing

Pay-per-result. You only pay for ads we deliver.

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Actor start | $0.001 |
| Ad scraped | $0.50 / 1,000 |

**Examples**:
- 100 ads = **$0.05** total
- 1,000 ads = **$0.50** total
- 10,000 ads = **$5.00** total

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Usage examples

### Paste any Ad Library URL

```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=all&ad_type=all&country=DE&q=baulig&search_type=keyword_exact_phrase&publisher_platforms[0]=facebook&publisher_platforms[1]=instagram&start_date[min]=2025-06-06"
  ],
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

### Search by keyword in a specific country

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Tesla Model 3", "electric vehicles"],
  "country": "US",
  "activeStatus": "ACTIVE",
  "mediaType": "VIDEO",
  "sortBy": "total_impressions_DESC",
  "maxAdsPerInput": 100
}
```

### Get all ads for a specific advertiser Page

```json
{
  "pageIds": ["165991287137890"],
  "maxAdsPerInput": 500
}
```

### Research political advertisers in the EU

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["vote 2026", "election"],
  "adType": "POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS",
  "country": "DE",
  "contentLanguages": ["de"],
  "maxAdsPerInput": 200
}
```

### Compare brand spend across markets

```json
{
  "advertiserNames": ["Nike"],
  "country": "ALL",
  "publisherPlatforms": ["facebook", "instagram"],
  "sortBy": "total_impressions_DESC",
  "maxAdsPerInput": 500
}
```

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/facebook-ad-library-scraper
```

Connect to Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, or any MCP client. Example prompt:

> Use facebook-ad-library-scraper to find the top 30 most-impressed Nike video ads in Germany from the last 90 days, including page like count and lifetime spend.

## Use cases

- **Competitive intelligence** — see every active ad from your competitors, plus their lifetime ad spend
- **Creative research** — analyse high-performing ad creative (body, hooks, CTAs, carousel structures) at scale
- **Political ad transparency** — track payers, beneficiaries, audience targeting, and EU reach for regulated ads
- **Market sizing** — measure category-level ad activity across countries and platforms
- **Lead generation** — identify companies actively spending on Meta ads in your vertical
- **Compliance auditing** — surface AI-generated, sensitive, or rule-violating ads

## Notes

- Meta's Ad Library is publicly accessible without login under their ad transparency policy
- Spend and reach figures are Meta's own estimates; not all ads include them (political/issue ads always do)
- Some newer ads may have a short delay before appearing in Library indexes
- `collation_id` lets you deduplicate ad variants — group results by `collation_id` to see distinct creatives
- **Proxy**: Meta tightly rate-limits datacenter IPs on the Ad Library search endpoint. Residential proxy is required for reliable scraping. Datacenter is accepted only as a debug/local-test option.
